units: kN, t, m, s, kPa; stress tension-positive (OpenSees sign)

elastic.note: SANISAND's stage-0 operator: G = G0 P_atm (2.97-e)^2/(1+e)

dp.note: tests/mpm_implicit_cases.txt:286-301 (232f/232j mild cone); staged materialState 0 first

elastic.element: LadrunoBrick -formulation bbar -geom linear, plane-strain slab (z fixed), sides fix x, base fixed

dp.element: LadrunoBrick -formulation bbar -geom linear, plane-strain slab (z fixed), sides fix x, base fixed
dp.stage0_route: parameter element e materialState over every element (all points)
dp.flip_route: parameter element e materialState over every element (all points)

sanisand.element: LadrunoBrick -formulation bbar -geom linear, plane-strain slab (z fixed), sides fix x, base fixed
sanisand.stage0_route: updateMaterialStage -material 1: reaches ONE element's points; the rest flip lazily (SANISAND without Elastic2Plastic; HS full transition)
sanisand.flip_route: updateMaterialStage -material 1: reaches ONE element's points; the rest flip lazily (SANISAND without Elastic2Plastic; HS full transition)

hs.element: LadrunoBrick -formulation bbar -geom linear, plane-strain slab (z fixed), sides fix x, base fixed
hs.stage0_route: updateMaterialStage -material 1: reaches ONE element's points; the rest flip lazily (SANISAND without Elastic2Plastic; HS full transition)
hs.flip_route: updateMaterialStage -material 1: reaches ONE element's points; the rest flip lazily (SANISAND without Elastic2Plastic; HS full transition)

closed_form.note: laterally confined (oedometric) isotropic elastic stage 0 with a constant nu: sigma_xx = sigma_zz = nu/(1-nu) sigma_yy; HS stage 0 uses nu_s0 = max(nu_ur, K0nc/(1+K0nc)), so the ratio is K0nc (LadrunoHS.cpp integrate3D stage 0)

meter_reference: sigma_ref(Y) = (sxx, syy, szz) of `particles` at the particle's initial Y, checkpoint after_hold (the stress the translation must keep): syy closed form, sxx and szz = the FE ratio to syy times syy
